$comment: The one list behind no-claude-p.py (PreToolUse) and no-claude-p-stop.py (Stop). It matches a headless Claude CLI call: the print flag, the model flag, a spawn of the claude binary and the argv form. The hooks tell the model to use the headless CLI the user chose, named in the GUARDHOOKS_HEADLESS_CLI environment variable. Patterns use syntax that Python re and JavaScript RegExp both accept, matched case-insensitive.

invocation.fix: run the prompt through the headless CLI this project chose instead of the Claude CLI in print mode
pass the model choice to the headless CLI this project chose
spawn the headless CLI this project chose, never the claude binary
build the argv for the headless CLI this project chose

fixtures.reply_fire: I will write a claude -p fixer for this.
fixtures.reply_pass: The job no longer uses claude -p; it runs the chosen CLI.
